takeaway.zh: 这是独立的本地示例，未调用该产品。产品资料用于了解方向，不证明示例中的数据或结果；实际能力请以官方产品为准。
takeaway.en: This independent local example does not call the product. Sources explain its purpose, not the fictional data or results. Check the official product for actual capabilities.

brief.zh: 墨西哥消费品制造商需要将 AI 代理接入多工厂生产所用的 ERP、质量系统和库存系统
brief.en: Mexican consumer goods manufacturer needs to connect AI agents to ERP, quality system, and inventory system used in multi-plant production

text.zh: 该墨西哥消费品制造商的 ERP 和库存系统已有 REST API，可通过薄包装层让 AI 代理调用现有端点读取多工厂生产的订单和库存数据，无需改动核心系统
text.en: The Mexican consumer goods manufacturer's ERP and inventory system already expose REST APIs. A thin wrapper layer can let AI agents call existing endpoints to read order and inventory data from multi-plant production without modifying core systems

quote.zh: 墨西哥消费品制造商的 ERP 和库存系统已有 REST API
quote.en: Mexican consumer goods manufacturer's ERP and inventory system already expose REST APIs

text.zh: 在多工厂生产流程中，质量系统通过专有协议与 ERP 通信。引入消息总线可统一事件流，AI 代理订阅质量检查和库存变动事件，但需为质量系统开发适配器
text.en: In multi-plant production, the quality system communicates with the ERP via proprietary protocol. Introducing a message bus can unify event streams, letting AI agents subscribe to quality checks and inventory changes, but requires developing an adapter for the quality system

quote.zh: 多工厂生产流程中，质量系统通过专有协议与 ERP 通信
quote.en: multi-plant production, the quality system communicates with the ERP via proprietary protocol

text.zh: 该墨西哥消费品制造商的三个遗留系统数据库结构复杂，建立只读副本供 AI 代理查询可避免影响多工厂生产的实时事务，但需持续同步和模式映射维护
text.en: The three legacy system databases at this Mexican consumer goods manufacturer have complex schemas. Building read replicas for AI agents to query avoids impacting real-time transactions in multi-plant production, but requires continuous synchronization and schema mapping maintenance

quote.zh: 墨西哥消费品制造商的三个遗留系统数据库结构复杂
quote.en: three legacy system databases at this Mexican consumer goods manufacturer have complex schemas

brief.zh: 拉美健身连锁需要将 AI 代理接入多地点运营所用的会员系统、排课系统和设备系统
brief.en: Latin American fitness chain needs to connect AI agents to membership system, scheduling system, and equipment system used in multi-location operations

text.zh: 该拉美健身连锁的会员系统和排课系统提供 REST API，支持多地点运营的课程查询和会员验证，AI 代理可通过轻量认证层直接调用，无需中间件
text.en: The Latin American fitness chain's membership system and scheduling system provide REST APIs supporting course queries and member verification across multi-location operations. AI agents can call them directly via a lightweight auth layer without middleware

quote.zh: 拉美健身连锁的会员系统和排课系统提供 REST API
quote.en: Latin American fitness chain's membership system and scheduling system provide REST APIs

systems.zh: 会员系统、排课系统、设备系统
systems.en: Membership system, scheduling system, equipment system

text.zh: 在多地点运营中，设备系统通过定时批处理向排课系统推送维护计划。引入消息总线让 AI 代理实时获取设备状态和排课冲突，但需为批处理流程添加事件发布逻辑
text.en: In multi-location operations, the equipment system pushes maintenance schedules to the scheduling system via periodic batch jobs. Introducing a message bus lets AI agents receive equipment status and scheduling conflicts in real time, but requires adding event publishing logic to batch processes

quote.zh: 多地点运营中，设备系统通过定时批处理向排课系统推送维护计划
quote.en: multi-location operations, the equipment system pushes maintenance schedules to the scheduling system via periodic batch jobs

systems.zh: 会员系统、排课系统、设备系统
systems.en: Membership system, scheduling system, equipment system

text.zh: 该拉美健身连锁的三个系统分布在不同数据中心支持多地点运营，建立跨区域只读副本供 AI 代理分析会员行为和设备使用模式，但网络延迟和数据一致性是挑战
text.en: The three systems at this Latin American fitness chain are distributed across data centers to support multi-location operations. Building cross-region read replicas for AI agents to analyze member behavior and equipment usage patterns poses challenges in network latency and data consistency

quote.zh: 拉美健身连锁的三个系统分布在不同数据中心支持多地点运营
quote.en: three systems at this Latin American fitness chain are distributed across data centers to support multi-location operations
